title: Agents and evidence per kind
request: Let agents answer a method question about any problem kind from that kind's own measured evidence, and let the intern read a kind's checks.
spec: Each kind has a research track with a first campaign, its pitfalls measured, its traps in the benchmark, and its tools in the registry; lessons are filed by kind; SFT trajectories carry the kind, and no kind's sealed cases ever enter a training set. Done when for each supported kind an agent asked a method question cites that kind's evidence, and the benchmark reports results per kind with intervals.
plan: Point every kind at a research track that exists.
Run each kind's acceptance on three seeds as a first campaign and store it as evidence with intervals.
Index the results as a new record type and give the intern a read-only tool for a kind's checks.
Test with method questions in a person's own words, one per kind.
Review, fix, and state what stays open.

decisions.decision: The campaign never overwrites a result and runs only from committed code.
decisions.why: Rewriting KND files broke the immutable-results rule, renumbering by sorted keys reused ids, and the first run recorded a commit that did not hold the code.

decisions.decision: The interval is over seeds, not over decision checks.
decisions.why: Checks on one seed share its data; pooling 21 checks gave [0.845, 1.0] where three seeds honestly give about [0.44, 1.0].

decisions.decision: Decisions waiting on the owner are listed as open, never as failures.
decisions.why: The missing pretrained encoder failed on every seed by construction and was reported as 'did not always hold'.

decisions.decision: The test's questions are in a person's words, frozen, for all fourteen kinds.
decisions.why: Questions that reused the records' phrases passed for nine kinds while 11 of 29 paraphrases missed.

change: dclab_rnd/kinds/campaign.py, dclab_rnd/evidence_index.py (_kind_records), dclab_rnd/research_map.py (kinds_v1 linked), dclab_rnd/kinds/*.py (evidence_track), dclab_rnd/tools.py and intern/tools.py (kind_checks), dclab_rnd/studio/trajectories.py (problem_kind), evidence/campaigns/kinds_v1 (README, manifest, KND results), tests/test_kinds_evidence.py, tests/test_agents_runtime.py, tests/test_trajectories.py.

findings.defect: An existing test counted the project's tools.
findings.scenario: test_agents_runtime asserted 24 project tools; with kind_checks there are 25.

findings.defect: The method-question test was narrow and fitted the records' wording.
findings.scenario: Nine kinds, questions reusing record phrases; 11 of 29 paraphrases missed (a recommender test offline, spatial cross validation, image splits).
findings.fix: Fourteen kinds, questions in a person's words, a second held-out set, the kinds' plain names (aliases) in their records, and one question asked through the registry tool the intern calls.

findings.defect: The benchmark does not report results per kind.
findings.scenario: The KND campaign stood in for it, though it is not the sealed benchmark.
findings.fix: Stated as open: no benchmark case is filed by kind yet.

findings.defect: Pitfalls per kind, traps in a new benchmark version and lessons by kind were not built.
findings.scenario: No new PIT record, benchmark version or lesson field.
findings.fix: Stated as open in the playbook and here.

findings.defect: The campaign overwrote results and renumbered kinds.
findings.scenario: A rerun rewrote KND-004 in place; a new kind sorting first would turn binary into KND-002 beside the old KND-002.
findings.cause: Ids from sorted keys; no existence check.
findings.fix: New ids after the highest on disk; a refusal to overwrite.

findings.defect: The provenance named a commit that did not hold the code.
findings.scenario: All results said ae8835a while campaign.py was untracked.
findings.fix: Full provenance plus whether the code that runs was committed; the campaign refuses otherwise and ran from bec23cb.

findings.scenario: A pooled interval over correlated checks; the encoder gap counted as a failure; 'held on every seed' on records with failures.
findings.cause: Checks treated as independent; limitations merged from every claim.
findings.fix: An interval over seeds, open decisions apart, failed seeds named, limitations from fact and risk claims only.

findings.defect: Research indexes would go stale and linked a missing README.
findings.scenario: INDEX.md counted 0 results and linked a README that did not exist.
findings.fix: README and manifest; results committed before the indexes are rebuilt.

findings.defect: Evidence search lost a rule answer.
findings.scenario: 'How many times can the final holdout be used?' lost DCLAB-R17 from its top five to kind records about holdouts (recall 0.700 to 0.692).
findings.cause: Kind records speak of holdouts often.
findings.fix: Measured and stated (RET result); a score weight tuned on the same questions was not applied.

findings.scenario: Reverting problem_kind on the records failed no test.
findings.fix: The export test requires the field on every record.

measurements.name: method questions cite the kind's own record (top five of keyword search)
measurements.gate: each of the 14 kinds, one question in a person's words, and a second set written before the aliases were measured; at least 12 of 14 per set must cite the kind's own record in the top five
measurements.result: Without aliases 9 of 14 worded questions; with the kinds' aliases 13 of 14 on the worded set (rare events missed: the fraud experiments rank first) and 13 of 14 on the held-out set (ranking missed). Evidence search recall at five on the 60 questions 0.692 against 0.700 before (RET-003).
measurements.against_gate: The bar of at least 12 of 14 per set holds; the aliases were chosen knowing the first set, so the held-out set is the fairer reading.
limits: Keyword search only; the neural retrieval was not measured with the kind records.
One question per kind per set.
measurements.next: Measure with the embedding retrieval once its vectors are rebuilt; add more questions per kind.

outcome: Built: every kind has a track, a first campaign with intervals over seeds, an evidence record agents cite, and a checks tool; the benchmark by kind, pitfalls by kind, traps in a new benchmark and lessons by kind remain open.
lessons: A result is immutable and names the code that made it: refuse to run from uncommitted code.
Intervals over correlated checks are too narrow: count the independent units.
A test of retrieval must use words a person would type, not the record's own.
Adding evidence can crowd out older evidence: measure retrieval before and after.
risks: A campaign standing in for a benchmark.
